narr: A cold front slowly approached during the afternoon of the 2nd before passing through that night. Showers and thunderstorms developed ahead of the front. There were multiple rounds of thunderstorms, so despite faster storm motion there were a few instances of flooding and flash flooding.
ev: The road was closed along the 4600 Block of Goldsboro Road due to high water. Three vehicles were trapped in fast flowing water.
lsr: ROAD CLOSED ON THE 4600 BLOCK OF GOLDSBORO ROAD DUE TO HIGH WATER. 3 VEHICLES STRANDED.
